statements.status_notes: GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx is fixed in pgx v5.9.2 but no fixed v4 release exists; pgx/v4 is in maintenance with no further security releases planned. The vulnerability requires a contrived combination of the non-default simple protocol, dollar-quoted string literals, and attacker-controlled placeholder text. Reachability through Telegraf's pgx/v4-using PostgreSQL plugins has not yet been audited; tracking with under_investigation pending that audit or migration of the dependency chain to pgx/v5.

GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx is fixed in pgx v5.9.2 but no fixed v4 release exists; pgx/v4 is in maintenance with no further security releases planned. The vulnerability requires a contrived combination of the non-default simple protocol, dollar-quoted string literals, and attacker-controlled placeholder text. Reachability through Telegraf's pgx/v4-using PostgreSQL plugins has not yet been audited; tracking with under_investigation pending that audit or migration of the dependency chain to pgx/v5.

GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx requires the non-default pgx simple protocol to be enabled. Vault uses pgx/v5 in its PostgreSQL paths and upstream documents pgx/v4 as present only because cloud.google.com/go/cloudsqlconn/postgres/pgxv4 remains in go.sum; code search shows no use of PreferSimpleProtocol, QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, simple_protocol, or prefer_simple_protocol, so the vulnerable simple-protocol execution path is not used.

Vault uses pgx/v5 in its PostgreSQL paths and upstream documents pgx/v4 as present only because cloud.google.com/go/cloudsqlconn/postgres/pgxv4 remains in go.sum; code search shows no use of PreferSimpleProtocol, QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, simple_protocol, or prefer_simple_protocol, so the vulnerable simple-protocol execution path is not used.

GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx requires the non-default pgx simple protocol to be enabled. Harbor configures pgx via a standard DSN in src/common/dao/pgsql.go and never sets PreferSimpleProtocol or QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, so the extended protocol (prepared statements) is always used and the dollar-quote placeholder confusion cannot occur.
